name: cms-orbit
description: Agent skills for CMS Orbit, the headless CMS from Bifröst Orbit: content modelling with the CLI, websites with the SDK, and drafting content through the MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Model content, build websites and draft content in CMS Orbit
interface.longDescription: Model content types and components in a CMS Orbit space with the CLI, build the website that renders them with the SDK, and find, read and draft content through the CMS Orbit MCP server. Every draft an agent makes waits for a person to review and publish it.
defaultPrompt: Add a gear list component to my CMS Orbit space
Build a Next.js website for my CMS Orbit space
Draft a page about our Lofoten trips and send it for review
